title: 第338章 两个条件第337章 炼化玄煌元塔
slug: 黑化后我称霸三千大世界
lines: 柳如烟看着周围的环境从山川美景幻化为水墨画，同时还伴随着一股灵威，接着柳如烟的目光又放在脚下的大阵上
吼！
下一秒，两头一白一黑的阴阳双龙从大阵当中涌出，并朝着柳如烟袭去，仅仅片刻的功夫，柳如烟整个人就被两头阴阳双龙团团围住
“想通过这样的方式来困住我？太幼稚了”
幽寒九转——第三转
三千里幽寒
随即在以柳如烟为中心，一股足以冻结虚空的寒气席卷周围三千里，如果不是柳如烟刻意的控制住，恐怕这寒气席卷的范围绝对不止三千里，甚至足以将整个州化为第二个冰河海域
咔嚓
当柳如烟的幽寒之力席卷三千里时，刘文达达山川河流也在仿佛间就被冻结成一幅冰画，段宏鑫的阴阳双龙也在即刻之间就化为冰雕
“该死的”
下方的段炳天见况，刘文达和段宏鑫居然连困住对方的一息时间都做不到，这让他如何夺回玄煌元塔
“别白费功夫了，本小姐想要的东西，你们阻止不了”
咔嚓
柳如烟见三人依旧不死心，于是在即刻之间就将山川界域以及阴阳困龙阵化为飞灰，挣脱出来的柳如烟将继续炼化手中的玄煌元塔
如今段家这三人已经对她没有任何威胁，只要将面前的人参鬼娃封印住，一切都好说
“大胆妖女，居然敢欺压我段家老祖和长老！”
接着不远处传来一道怒喝声，同时两道身影也出现在柳如烟的身前
来人是段家家主段斌傅和段家少主段天，此时的段天还是那满面桃花的模样，很显然是刚刚炼化完一名女子
“你就是段家家主？”
柳如烟看着来人修为不过是大乘巅峰，这对于她来说不过是弹指之间就可以灭掉的蚂蚁而已
“大胆，你一个妖女居然敢如此轻视吾父，该当何罪！”
段天见是柳如烟，眼中的色欲根本无法止住，同时又装出一副为家族敢死的作态
“不愧是本少主看上的女人，这姿色简直令人欲罢不能”
看着柳如烟，段天心中的色欲就更加按耐不住并暗道
“父亲，此女对我段家不敬，应当擒拿加以拷问！”
随即段天德目光就放在自己的父亲段斌傅的身上，柳如烟他没有把握擒拿，但他的父亲是大乘巅峰，拿下柳如烟不过是轻轻松松的事情罢了
而段斌傅的目光则是看着柳如烟，随后又将目光扫过周围，人参鬼娃，一般的段家更是被屠杀，如此惨状难道是面前的女子造成的？
老祖和其他长老呢？
“你这个逆孙！”
这时下方的段炳天闻言心中的怒意直接对段天怒喝道，如果不是这个逆孙在外乱惹事，他们段家又怎么可能会招惹到如此逆天的人物？
”祖爷爷，您这是怎么了？究竟是谁伤了你？“
段天和段斌傅追声闻言，都将目光放在下方，结果看见他们都祖爷爷身受重伤的躺在地上，于是并纷纷来到段炳天的身边
啪！
轰！
“混账东西，如果不是你在外招惹来的人，本老祖怎么可能会受到如此？”
段炳天怒不可遏的一巴掌将段天扇飞，将段天重重的啪飞出几百远
“老祖，您这是？”
段斌傅不思所以的看着自己的儿子就这样被老祖扇飞，但他也不好说什么，只能先听听老祖究竟是为了什么而打天儿
“哼，你也有过，子不教父之过，如果你不好好的看住这个逆孙，我们段家又怎么可能会落到如此境地！”
content_en:
Liu Ruyan watched the surrounding environment transform from the beautiful scenery of mountains and rivers into ink paintings, accompanied by a spiritual power, and then Liu Ruyan's eyes turned to the large formation at his feet.
Roar!
The next second, two yin and yang dragons, one white and one black, emerged from the formation and attacked Liu Ruyan. In just a moment, Liu Ruyan was surrounded by the two yin and yang dragons.
"You want to trap me in this way? It's too childish."
Nine rounds of Youhan - the third round
Three Thousand Miles of Coldness
Immediately, with Liu Ruyan as the center, a cold air that was enough to freeze the void swept around three thousand miles. If Liu Ruyan had not deliberately controlled it, I am afraid that the scope of this cold air would have been more than three thousand miles, and even enough to turn the entire state into a second glacial sea.
click
When Liu Ruyan's cold power swept across three thousand miles, Liu Wendada's mountains and rivers seemed to be frozen into an ice painting in an instant, and Duan Hongxin's Yin and Yang dragons also instantly turned into ice sculptures.
"Damn"
Duan Bingtian below saw the situation. Liu Wenda and Duan Hongxin couldn't even trap each other for one breath. How could he regain the Xuanhuang Yuan Pagoda?
"Don't waste your efforts. You can't stop what I want."
click
Liu Ruyan saw that the three of them still refused to give up, so he immediately turned the mountains and rivers realm and the Yin-Yang Trap Dragon Formation into ashes. Liu Ruyan who broke free would continue to refine the Xuanhuang Yuan Pagoda in his hand.
Now the three members of the Duan family pose no threat to her. As long as she seals the ginseng ghost baby in front of her, everything will be easy.
"The bold witch actually dares to bully my ancestors and elders of the Duan family!"
Then there was an angry shout not far away, and at the same time two figures appeared in front of Liu Ruyan
The visitors were Duan Binfu, the head of the Duan family, and Duan Tian, the young head of the Duan family. At this time, Duan Tian still looked like he was full of peach blossoms. It was obvious that he had just finished refining a woman.
"Are you the head of the Duan family?"
Liu Ruyan saw that the person who came was only at the peak of Mahayana cultivation. To her, he was just an ant that could be eliminated with a snap of his fingers.
"How dare you, a witch, dare to despise my father like this? What kind of crime do you deserve!"
When Duan Tian saw it was Liu Ruyan, he couldn't stop the lust in his eyes, and at the same time he pretended to be willing to die for his family.
"She is indeed the woman that I have fallen in love with. Her beauty is simply irresistible."
Looking at Liu Ruyan, the lust in Duan Tian's heart became even more unbearable and he secretly thought
"Father, this woman is disrespectful to our Duan family and should be captured and tortured!"
Duan Tiande then set his sights on his father, Duan Binfu. He was not sure about capturing Liu Ruyan, but his father was at the pinnacle of Mahayana, and capturing Liu Ruyan was just an easy matter.
Duan Binfu looked at Liu Ruyan, and then glanced around. The ginseng ghost baby and the general Duan family were slaughtered. Could such a tragic situation be caused by the woman in front of him?
Where are the ancestors and other elders?
"You rebellious grandson!"
At this time, Duan Bingtian, who was below, heard the anger in his heart and shouted angrily at Duan Tian, if this unfaithful grandson hadn't been causing trouble outside, how could the Duan family have provoked such an unfaithful person?
"Grandpa Zu, what's wrong with you? Who hurt you?"
When Duan Tian and Duan Bin heard this, they both looked down and saw their grandfather lying on the ground seriously injured, so they all came to Duan Bingtian's side.
Snap!
boom!
"You bastard, if you hadn't provoked the people outside, how could this ancestor have been treated like this?"
Duan Bingtian was furious and slapped Duan Tian away, sending Duan Tian flying hundreds of miles away with heavy slaps.
"Ancestor, what are you doing?"
Duan Bin and Fu Busi watched in disbelief as his son was slapped away by his ancestor, but he couldn't say anything. He could only first listen to what the ancestor was fighting for.
"Humph, you have also made the mistake of not being a godfather. If you don't take good care of this rebellious grandson, how could our Duan family end up in such a situation!"
